build.command: apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl unzip && curl -sL https://github.com/projectdiscovery/nuclei/releases/latest/download/nuclei_linux_amd64.zip -o nuclei.zip && unzip nuclei.zip && mv nuclei /usr/local/bin/ && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/nuclei && rm nuclei.zip && pip install -r requirements.txt
